summary: Manager Chris Klevan runs a coaching 1-1 with closer Andrew, reviewing two recent calls (Jared and Marion). He also scripts a $100 refundable deposit as the condition for booking a follow-up call and instructs Andrew never to back down on it.

The scripted trust rebuttal leans on Trevor's social following and 'if we were taking that amount of money from people and not delivering, we'd be in jail' as proof of legitimacy.
Chris tells Andrew to avoid pre-call contact with setters because it biases the closer; separately says a prospect 'probably shouldn't have been set'.
Chris estimates a booked follow-up converts at roughly 5% versus ~40% live on the call — relevant to how follow_up dispositions should be read.
